# corridor 1: dakar_djibouti - anchors [4948, 4927, 2056, 2081, 12806, 8124] - gate path, 12 states
# Sets _rc_ok = 0 unless every gate state is same-side with the anchor
# (= controller of the first endpoint's state). Order: endpoint A, endpoint B,
# then the rest - two reads kill the walk when the ends are not even allied.

# corridor 2: pretoria_khartoum - anchors [13606, 10929, 14146, 12911, 12989, 12806] - gate path, 12 states
# Sets _rc_ok = 0 unless every gate state is same-side with the anchor
# (= controller of the first endpoint's state). Order: endpoint A, endpoint B,
# then the rest - two reads kill the walk when the ends are not even allied.
WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_gate_2 = {
	set_temp_variable = { _rc_ok = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { _rc_anchor = 0 }
	275 = { CONTROLLER = { set_temp_variable = { _rc_anchor = THIS.id } } }
	# an unset anchor must fail the gate, never reach a var: compare as garbage
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { _rc_anchor = 0 } } set_temp_variable = { _rc_ok = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					275 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					551 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					545 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					771 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					1098 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					770 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					1101 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					546 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					1099 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					548 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					549 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					1096 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { _rc_ok = 0 }
	}
}

# Built EDGE BY EDGE (path = { a b }), the only build_railway form this repo has
# proven in campaigns (PC core uses it for every railway project). A 30-province
# path list no-opped silently on the 2026-08-27 owner test (corridor 1: built flag
# set, zero track on the map) while shorter-legged corridors built - per-edge builds
# salvage every good edge, log each refused one, and keep the PC mirror honest:
# the mirror (readers: PC railway_helpers/_core, WA_AI_pathfinding_effects) is
# stamped ONLY for an edge that passed can_build_railway and was actually built.

# corridor 3: prayagraj_karachi - anchors [7938, 3456] - gate path, 5 states
# Sets _rc_ok = 0 unless every gate state is same-side with the anchor
# (= controller of the first endpoint's state). Order: endpoint A, endpoint B,
# then the rest - two reads kill the walk when the ends are not even allied.
WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_gate_3 = {
	set_temp_variable = { _rc_ok = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { _rc_anchor = 0 }
	438 = { CONTROLLER = { set_temp_variable = { _rc_anchor = THIS.id } } }
	# an unset anchor must fail the gate, never reach a var: compare as garbage
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { _rc_anchor = 0 } } set_temp_variable = { _rc_ok = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					438 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					443 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					436 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					437 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					433 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { _rc_ok = 0 }
	}
}

# Built EDGE BY EDGE (path = { a b }), the only build_railway form this repo has
# proven in campaigns (PC core uses it for every railway project). A 30-province
# path list no-opped silently on the 2026-08-27 owner test (corridor 1: built flag
# set, zero track on the map) while shorter-legged corridors built - per-edge builds
# salvage every good edge, log each refused one, and keep the PC mirror honest:
# the mirror (readers: PC railway_helpers/_core, WA_AI_pathfinding_effects) is
# stamped ONLY for an edge that passed can_build_railway and was actually built.

# corridor 4: karachi_fars - anchors [3456, 10797] - gate path, 4 states
# Sets _rc_ok = 0 unless every gate state is same-side with the anchor
# (= controller of the first endpoint's state). Order: endpoint A, endpoint B,
# then the rest - two reads kill the walk when the ends are not even allied.
WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_gate_4 = {
	set_temp_variable = { _rc_ok = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { _rc_anchor = 0 }
	443 = { CONTROLLER = { set_temp_variable = { _rc_anchor = THIS.id } } }
	# an unset anchor must fail the gate, never reach a var: compare as garbage
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { _rc_anchor = 0 } } set_temp_variable = { _rc_ok = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					443 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					412 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					444 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					410 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { _rc_ok = 0 }
	}
}

# Built EDGE BY EDGE (path = { a b }), the only build_railway form this repo has
# proven in campaigns (PC core uses it for every railway project). A 30-province
# path list no-opped silently on the 2026-08-27 owner test (corridor 1: built flag
# set, zero track on the map) while shorter-legged corridors built - per-edge builds
# salvage every good edge, log each refused one, and keep the PC mirror honest:
# the mirror (readers: PC railway_helpers/_core, WA_AI_pathfinding_effects) is
# stamped ONLY for an edge that passed can_build_railway and was actually built.
WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_build_4 = {
	if = { limit = { can_build_railway = { path = { 3456 1179 } } }

		set_variable = { global.WA_AI_PC_railway_connections^3456 = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.WA_AI_PC_railway_connections^1179 = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.WA_AI_PC_railway_connection_level_3456^1179 = @WA_RAIL_CORRIDOR_LEVEL }
		set_variable = { global.WA_AI_PC_railway_connection_level_1179^3456 = @WA_RAIL_CORRIDOR_LEVEL }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_railway_connection = { path = { 3456 1179 } } } }
		log = "[GetDateText] WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR: corridor 4 edge 3456-1179 REFUSED by can_build_railway and not already railed"
	}
	if = { limit = { can_build_railway = { path = { 1179 7917 } } }
		build_railway = { level = @WA_RAIL_CORRIDOR_LEVEL path = { 1179 7917 } }

# corridor 7: casablanca_cairo - anchors [7069, 1145, 11969, 1149, 11954, 4076, 7011] - gate na_full, 32 states
# Sets _rc_ok = 0 unless every gate state is same-side with the anchor
# (= controller of the first endpoint's state). Order: endpoint A, endpoint B,
# then the rest - two reads kill the walk when the ends are not even allied.
WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_gate_7 = {
	set_temp_variable = { _rc_ok = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { _rc_anchor = 0 }
	461 = { CONTROLLER = { set_temp_variable = { _rc_anchor = THIS.id } } }

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { _rc_anchor = 0 } } set_temp_variable = { _rc_ok = 0 } }
	if = {

# Built EDGE BY EDGE (path = { a b }), the only build_railway form this repo has
# proven in campaigns (PC core uses it for every railway project). A 30-province
# path list no-opped silently on the 2026-08-27 owner test (corridor 1: built flag
# set, zero track on the map) while shorter-legged corridors built - per-edge builds
# salvage every good edge, log each refused one, and keep the PC mirror honest:
# the mirror (readers: PC railway_helpers/_core, WA_AI_pathfinding_effects) is
# stamped ONLY for an edge that passed can_build_railway and was actually built.

# corridor 8: miami_halifax - anchors [1843, 3957, 3878, 6732, 7361] - gate path, 18 states
# Sets _rc_ok = 0 unless every gate state is same-side with the anchor
# (= controller of the first endpoint's state). Order: endpoint A, endpoint B,
# then the rest - two reads kill the walk when the ends are not even allied.
WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_gate_8 = {
	set_temp_variable = { _rc_ok = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { _rc_anchor = 0 }
	366 = { CONTROLLER = { set_temp_variable = { _rc_anchor = THIS.id } } }
	# an unset anchor must fail the gate, never reach a var: compare as garbage
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { _rc_anchor = 0 } } set_temp_variable = { _rc_ok = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					366 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					464 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					816 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					365 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					364 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					363 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					362 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					361 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					831 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					830 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					835 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					834 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					840 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					357 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					843 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					838 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					839 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
					465 = { WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_state_is_friendly = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { _rc_ok = 0 }
	}
}

# Built EDGE BY EDGE (path = { a b }), the only build_railway form this repo has
# proven in campaigns (PC core uses it for every railway project). A 30-province
# path list no-opped silently on the 2026-08-27 owner test (corridor 1: built flag
# set, zero track on the map) while shorter-legged corridors built - per-edge builds
# salvage every good edge, log each refused one, and keep the PC mirror honest:
# the mirror (readers: PC railway_helpers/_core, WA_AI_pathfinding_effects) is
# stamped ONLY for an edge that passed can_build_railway and was actually built.
WA_AI_RAIL_CORRIDOR_build_8 = {
	if = { limit = { can_build_railway = { path = { 1843 1913 } } }
		build_railway = { level = @WA_RAIL_CORRIDOR_LEVEL path = { 1843 1913 } }
		set_variable = { global.WA_AI_PC_railway_connections^1843 = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.WA_AI_PC_railway_connections^1913 = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.WA_AI_PC_railway_connection_level_1843^1913 = @WA_RAIL_CORRIDOR_LEVEL }
